messages:
Maya: Quick pulse from today's all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses. Can leadership confirm the top three product or ops gaps we should escalate now?

cto_rene: Short answer: 1) vendor-managed private deployments (sales asks) 2) KMS/HSM support + audit export (compliance ask) 3) predictable unit economics for massive embedding workloads.

Jordan_sales: Field color: wins = clear SLA + cost transparency; losses = procurement friction and no vendor-managed option. Also some deals lost to competitors offering month-long dedicated trials.

DevOps_Liz: From ops perspective: vendor-managed private reduces procurement friction but raises support overhead. If we proceed, require a hardened runbook and a rollback strategy.

PM_Ravi: Actionable asks: A) one-pager for sales describing vendor-managed private and interim mitigations (owner: Jordan_sales) B) scope HSM/KMS integration spike (owner: DevOps_Liz + infra) C) embedding pricing experiment (owner: Ravi). Can we get owners to confirm?

Jordan_sales: Confirming owner for one-pager. Will deliver a buyer-facing note + sample email within 4 business days.

DevOps_Liz: I'll kick off a 2-week spike for BYOK KMS and audit export feasibility. Will post findings and acceptance criteria in this thread.

cto_rene: Leadership note: prioritize vendor-managed private for regulated customers (P0). HSM/KMS and embedding-econ playbooks are P1. We'll review timelines in next leadership sync.

NoteBot: Recording + meeting notes: https://redwood.internal/allhands/2415000000 - action items added to tracker.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Please drop any anonymized win/loss quotes for PM/marketing to use in positioning. :thumbsup:
